source.name: Footy Headlines: Newcastle Jets 26-27 AFC Champions League Elite Home & Away Kits Released
source.note: The ACL Elite home kit is a separate shirt from the club's 2026/27 A-League home jersey (which carries Oz Shipping Containers on the front, per the club's 2 Oct 2026 announcement: https://newcastlejetsfc.com.au/news/oz-shipping-increases-commitment-to-newcastle-jets-as-new-major-partner/). Wadam Living sits across the midriff.
source.quote: Both shirts feature the club crest, New Balance logos, and the Wadam Living sponsor across the midriff, as well as the official AFC Champions League Elite tournament sleeve patch on the right arm

source.name: Footy Headlines: Newcastle Jets 26-27 AFC Champions League Elite Home & Away Kits Released
source.note: Kit supplier; New Balance logo on the chest of the launch photos. Recorded for the placement the announcement gives it in the shirt lineup.
source.quote: Crafted by New Balance, the special collection takes direct inspiration from the kits worn during the club's very first Asian continental adventure back in 2009

summary: Newcastle Jets 2026/27 AFC Champions League Elite home kit (New Balance supplier), a 2009-throwback shirt separate from the club's 2026/27 A-League Men's home jersey, which per the club's 2 Oct 2026 announcement has Oz Shipping Containers on the front. The cited source (Footy Headlines, 11 Sep 2026) records the front sponsor (Wadam Living across the midriff), the club crest, the New Balance logos and the AFC Champions League Elite competition patch on the right arm. sponsorsComplete is false: no cited source enumerates every placement — the back, shorts and any back-of-shirt sponsor are not covered by a cited source (club-shop and match photos were used by the researcher but aren't cited here).
headline: The shirt is {level}: Wadam Living, business name of a Newcastle-area private company, pays for the front of the ACL Elite shirt.
